title: Dialogues

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for each speaker's goal and the detail that changes the exchange. First read for meaning; then cover the English and summarize each person's point.

steps.title: Choosing a course
steps.body: Two classmates compare a fictional evening program and a weekend program.

examples.fr: La formation du soir commencera en septembre.
examples.en: Mina: The evening program will start in September.

examples.fr: Quand le centre confirmera l'horaire, tu pourras décider ?
examples.en: Luc: When the centre confirms the schedule, will you be able to decide?

examples.fr: Oui. Si les cours finissent avant vingt heures, je prendrai le bus.
examples.en: Mina: Yes. If classes finish before eight p.m., I will take the bus.

examples.fr: Et si l'horaire ne convient pas ?
examples.en: Luc: And if the schedule does not work?

examples.fr: Je reporterai ma candidature au prochain trimestre.
examples.en: Mina: I will postpone my application until the next term.

steps.title: A deadline to confirm
steps.body: A learner calls a training office about a fictional application.

examples.fr: Bonjour, je voudrais confirmer la date limite.
examples.en: Awa: Hello, I would like to confirm the deadline.
Agent: You will receive an email tomorrow.

examples.fr: Quand je recevrai le message, je vérifierai les prérequis.
examples.en: Awa: When I receive the message, I will check the prerequisites.

examples.fr: Si vous avez une question, vous pourrez nous écrire.
examples.en: Agent: If you have a question, you can write to us.

examples.fr: Merci. Je vous tiendrai au courant après avoir comparé les horaires.
examples.en: Awa: Thank you. I will keep you updated after comparing the schedules.
